# git-filter-repo (vendored)

`git_filter_repo.py` is [git-filter-repo](https://github.com/newren/git-filter-repo) v2.47.0, the file
`git-filter-repo` at tag v2.47.0, renamed so Python can import it as a module. Its SHA-256 as committed (LF line
endings) is `67447413e273fc76809289111748870b6f6072f08b17efe94863a92d810b7d94`. It's MIT licensed: see `COPYING` and
`COPYING.mit`.

`scripts/publish/rewrite.py` uses it as a library to build the public copy of this repository's history
(CLAUDE.md, Section 0.4).
